name: Does rotating a PDF upload my file to a server?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Rotation is processed entirely in your browser. Your files are never sent anywhere.

name: Can I rotate only specific pages, not the whole PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can choose to rotate all pages or select individual pages to rotate.
PDFree supports 90°, 180°, and 270° rotation for any page selection.

name: Is there a file size limit for rotating PDFs?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. There are no file size or page count limits.

name: Is the PDF rotator completely free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. PDFree is free with no subscription, no daily limits, and no signup. No watermarks are added to the output.

name: Does the rotation save permanently to my PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Clicking Rotate PDF generates a new PDF file that downloads to your device with the rotation permanently applied. It will display in the corrected orientation in any PDF viewer.

name: Does PDFree store or log my files after processing?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. PDFree runs entirely in your browser — there is no backend server that receives your files. Because nothing is uploaded, nothing can be stored, logged, or retained. Your document exists only in your browser's memory for the duration of the session and is cleared when you close the tab.

name: Can I rotate multiple PDF files at once?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rotate works with one PDF at a time, so you can fine-tune each page's rotation individually — for example, fixing only the sideways pages in a scanned document while leaving the rest untouched. For batches of files that all need the exact same treatment, PDFree's other tools like Compress and Watermark support processing several files at once.
